faq.q: What time does the pre-concert cruise depart?
faq.a: The pre-concert cruise departs Puerto Banús 1 hour before the Starlite 2042 showtime. For a typical 21:00 concert, you'd board at 19:30, cruise until 21:30, then head to the auditorium. We can adjust departure slightly based on your ticket time.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: We recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) for a 2-hour sunset charter at €749. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from 4 hours at €4,719 and includes a free jet ski. Other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge can be arranged on request.

faq.q: Is the price per person or per boat?
faq.a: All prices are per boat, not per person. The 2-hour Tier A charter costs €749 total for up to 9 or 11 guests (depending on the boat). The Mangusta 80 4-hour charter is €4,719 for up to 12 guests. This includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your concert ticket and a good mood.

faq.q: How do I get from Puerto Banús to Starlite?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is about 10 minutes by car from the Starlite auditorium in Nagüeles. We can arrange a private taxi transfer for you (extra cost) or you can drive and park. The cruise returns to the port at least 30 minutes before showtime, giving you plenty of time to travel.

faq.q: Can I extend the cruise to include dinner?
faq.a: Yes, you can upgrade to a 3- or 4-hour charter to include a dinner stop at a beach club like La Plage or a sunset anchor at Cala del Faro. Alternatively, book a 2-hour cruise and enjoy dinner at a Puerto Banús restaurant like Bibo or Los Bandidos before the concert.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Your safety is paramount. If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we'll reschedule your charter or issue a full refund. Starlite dates are fixed, so we recommend booking a flexible charter and checking the forecast 48 hours ahead.

Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and concert time. We'll confirm availability and send a booking link. A 50% deposit secures the slot, with the balance due 7 days before departure.

data.body_html:
Combine the glamour of a luxury yacht charter from Puerto Banús with the world-class music of Starlite 2042. Our pre-concert cruises depart 1 hour before showtime, giving you a sunset sail along the Marbella coastline with drinks, snacks, and sea views — then you head straight to the auditorium in Nagüeles. Whether you choose a 2-hour charter on an Astondoa 40 for €749 or a longer escape on a Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski, this is the ultimate way to start your Starlite night.

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Works for Starlite 2042

Starlite 2042 runs from July to August at the Nagüeles Auditorium, a 10-minute drive from Puerto Banús. A pre-concert cruise solves two problems: it beats the traffic and turns transit into an experience. Depart at 19:30 for a 21:00 show, cruise past the Golden Mile villas, Cabopino beach, and the Sierra Blanca mountains, then return to port by 21:00. You arrive at the concert relaxed, fed, and with a glass of cava still in hand.

Our Recommended Boats for Starlite Evenings

For a 2-hour sunset charter, the Tier A boats are perfect:

  • Astondoa 40 — 12.5m, 9 passengers, €749 for 2 hours
  • Azimut 39 — 12.5m, 11 passengers, €749 for 2 hours

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. For larger parties or a more premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski — ideal if you want to anchor at Cala del Faro before the concert.

What's Included in Every Charter

All our charters are all-inclusive. You pay one price and get:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full cruise duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts, fresh fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no hidden taxes

You just bring your Starlite ticket, sunscreen, and a camera.

Sample Itinerary: 2-Hour Pre-Concert Cruise

Assuming a 21:00 concert start:

  • 19:30 — Board your boat at Puerto Banús, meet the skipper, receive a safety briefing
  • 19:45 — Depart the marina, head west past the Golden Mile and La Concha mountain
  • 20:00 — Anchor briefly off Cabopino or Cala del Faro for a swim (weather permitting) or just cruise with drinks
  • 20:45 — Turn back toward Puerto Banús, enjoy sunset over the Mediterranean
  • 21:00 — Dock at Puerto Banús, disembark
  • 21:15 — Private taxi to Nagüeles (10 min, ~€15-20)
  • 21:30 — Arrive at Starlite auditorium, grab your seat

Combine with Dinner or a Longer Charter

If you want more time on the water, upgrade to a 3- or 4-hour charter. Anchor at a beach club like La Plage for a seafood lunch, or cruise to Estepona and back. Alternatively, book a 2-hour cruise and enjoy dinner at a Puerto Banús restaurant such as Bibo, Los Bandidos, or Ocean Club before the concert. We can arrange a table reservation on request.

Booking & Cancellation Policy

Book via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and concert time. A 50% deposit secures the slot; the balance is due 7 days before departure. Cancellations made 14+ days before the charter receive a full refund; 7-13 days, 50% refund; less than 7 days, no refund unless we cancel due to weather or mechanical issues. We recommend travel insurance for peace of mind.
